name: Zermatt
tagline: A car-free village beneath the Matterhorn
summary: Zermatt is a car-free Alpine village of wooden chalets beneath the Matterhorn, Switzerland's most famous peak. Ride the Gornergrat railway, walk past lakes that mirror the mountain, ski year-round on the glacier and dine in mountain huts.
seasonNote: Winter is for skiing; summer for hiking (July to September). Glacier skiing runs all year. Many places close in May and November.
arrival: Cars stop at Täsch; take the shuttle train. Trains from Visp take about an hour, and the Glacier Express links St. Moritz.
gettingAround: Walk, electric taxis and mountain railways.
cashTip: Cards and phone payments work almost everywhere; prices are in francs, and euros get a poor rate.
baseArea: Village centre with a Matterhorn view
